objective: Test whether the source-and-donor-component-disjoint bilinear identity head, when coupled as a bounded recurrent-output gate and trained for exactly eight updates, produces heldout causal answer preference for the correct recurrent state without changing the projected carrier.

feature_reconstruction.required: Replay the signed 176-row fit exactly and require byte-stable reconstructed head state plus exact signed-analysis reproduction before model load.

architecture.bilinear_head: 42 identity-plus-rank4 residual query/state maps reconstructed from the passed crossfit
architecture.projected_carrier: frozen and held by reference across correct, zero-recurrent, matched-donor, layer-permuted, and projected-only-bypass conditions
architecture.zero_identity: zero recurrent state must produce logits byte-identical to the explicit projected-only bypass

training.answer_objective: correct-state answer CE plus active zero-recurrent, matched-donor, and layer-permuted CE hinges
training.control_graphs: metric forwards and active backward graphs serialized so at most one full-vocabulary autograd graph exists per rank
training.output_gate_checkpoint: Save one local output-gate-only safetensors checkpoint with a signed file hash for a separately preregistered benchmark; never include it in git.

heldout_causal_endpoint.selection: All whole donor components held out from the 176-row bilinear fit. No endpoint row or its mapped donor trained the head, and the endpoint dataset is separate from the eight-update fit dataset.
heldout_causal_endpoint.reuse_disclosure: The endpoint's frozen query/state features were previously used only to evaluate the preregistered internal identity gates. Answer logits and causal CE controls were not evaluated during crossfit. Passing this endpoint supports causal coupling but is not a second independent identity replication.

stopping_rule.endpoint_pass: Authorize only a separately locked 220-row open native generation benchmark against projected-only, matched-donor, and layer-permuted controls.
stopping_rule.endpoint_failure: Retire the bilinear output-gate family without changing gain, batch size, learning rate, or update count on this endpoint; advance to rotary binding mechanics.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, strength holdout, or any other protected split.

claim_policy.endpoint_pass: May claim heldout teacher-forced causal preference on the disclosed crossfit-heldout open development components.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden until the separately locked native generation benchmark beats projected-only and both recurrent controls by its preregistered margin.
claim_policy.sota: Forbidden until the native gain is replicated and compared under the locked benchmark contract.
